TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT trim(A.CUS_KEY) as cus_key, CASE WHEN CB.OLD_BR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) = 1 THEN '1000000000000' || TO_CHAR(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) WHEN LENGTH(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) = 2 THEN '100000000000' || TO_CHAR(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) WHEN LENGTH(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) = 3 THEN '10000000000' || TO_CHAR(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) END ELSE TO_CHAR(CB.NEW_CHANNEL_ID) END AS CHANNEL_ID, CASE WHEN CB.OLD_BR IS NULL THEN TO_CHAR(A.ORG_UNIT_ID) -- force to CHAR ELSE TO_CHAR(CB.NEW_BR) END AS ORG_UNIT_ID, A.OFFICER_ID, A.LOB_ID
FROM atomic.cust A LEFT JOIN ATOMIC.COMBINED_BRANCHES CB ON A.ORG_UNIT_ID = CB.OLD_BR

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
( SELECT CAST(LO_NUM AS VARCHAR(50)) AS Application_ID, --CAST(ID_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(1)) AS ID_NUMBER, CAST(CURY_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS ISO_CURRENCY_CD, CAST(1 AS INT) AS Volume, CAST('0' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS TRANS_AMOUNT, CAST('AFU' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS TRANSACTION_GROUP, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_ID, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_KEY, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUSTOMER_ID, CAST(DATE'2025-08-31' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE, CASE WHEN (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY = 950 OR PROD_SBTYPE_KEY = 975) AND ACCt_MIDAS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ACCt_MIDAS_ID else CAST(COALESCE(card_no ,prod_key,lo_num) AS VARCHAR(50)) end AS SRC_ID_NUMBER, CAST(PROD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(50)) AS PRODUCT_TYPE, CAST(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 1 THEN '1000000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 2 THEN '100000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 3 THEN '10000000000' || SRC_CD END AS DECIMAL(14,0)) AS CHANNEL_ID, CAST(DCSN AS VARCHAR(50)) AS STATUS , --CAST (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY AS VARCHAR (10)) AS LOAN_SUB_TYPE_KEY, CASE WHEN UPPER(PRODUCT_TYPE) LIKE '%CREDIT CARD%' THEN CARD_TYPE ELSE CAST (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY AS VARCHAR (10)) END AS JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP ,APP_SALV_DT ,DCSN_RSN
/*SELECT cust_key, COALESCE(card_no ,prod_key,lo_num)as prod_key ,card_no */
FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_LO lo
LEFT JOIN BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_LO_LD ld ON ld.ORG_LO_KEY=lo.LO_NUM where (CAST( CAST( DCSN_DT AS TIMESTAMP(0) FORMAT 'HH:MI:SSBDDBMMMBYYYY' ) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE'2025-08-01' AND DATE'2025-08-31' AND RCORD_FLG='D' AND DATE'2025-08-31' BETWEEN STRT_DT AND END_DT)
union sel MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY AS APPLICATION_ID, CAST(LOAN_CCY_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS ISO_CURRENCY_CD, CAST(1 AS INT) AS Volume, CAST('0' AS VARCHAR(1)) AS TRANS_AMOUNT, CAST('AFU' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS TRANSACTION_GROUP, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_ID, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_KEY, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUSTOMER_ID, CAST(DATE'2025-08-31' AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE, CAST(COALESCE(PROD_KEY ,MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY) AS VARCHAR(50)) AS SRC_ID_NUMBER, CAST(PROD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(50)) AS PRODUCT_TYPE, CAST(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 1 THEN '1000000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 2 THEN '100000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 3 THEN '10000000000' || SRC_CD END AS DECIMAL(14,0)) AS CHANNEL_ID, CAST(DCSN AS VARCHAR(50)) AS STATUS ,
'Mortgage LOAN'AS JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP, RVSD_DT , DCSN_RSN
FROM( SELECT MG_LO_KEY ,CUST_KEY ,ID_NO ,ED_LVL ,SRC_CD ,PRG_CD ,SLS_AGNT_CD ,DCSN ,DCSN_DT ,INSTL_AMT ,SEGMT_CD ,CUST_SEGMT ,DCSN_RSN ,RECVD_DT ,DISBD_AMT ,PROD_TYPE ,PROD_KEY ,LOAN_CCY_KEY ,RVSD_DT --sel * from (sel * FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_MG_LO WHERE date'2025-08-31' between STRT_DT and END_DT AND DCSN_DT BETWEEN date'2025-08-01' and date'2025-08-31'--CHANGED AS PER BUSNIESS REQUEST -The interval for date will be two months back AND RCORD_FLG = 'D' )MG_LO
left JOIN( SELECT MG_LO_KEY ,ENGL_NM ,GNDR ,NTLTY_KEY ,MRTL_STS ,CUST_HOME_NUM ,BIRTH_DT FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_MG_LO_CUST WHERE date'2025-08-31' between STRT_DT and END_DT AND RCORD_FLG = 'D' )LO_CUST ON LO_CUST.MG_LO_KEY = MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY)

ATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
ATTRIBUTE.VALUE:
SELECT CAST(LO_NUM AS VARCHAR(50)) AS Application_ID, --CAST(ID_NUMBER AS VARCHAR(1)) AS ID_NUMBER, CAST(CURY_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS ISO_CURRENCY_CD, CAST(1 AS INT) AS Volume, LO_AMT AS TRANS_AMOUNT, CAST('AFU' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS TRANSACTION_GROUP, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_ID, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_KEY, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUSTOMER_ID, CAST($$Date AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE, CASE WHEN (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY = 950 OR PROD_SBTYPE_KEY = 975) AND ACCt_MIDAS_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ACCt_MIDAS_ID else CAST(COALESCE(card_no ,prod_key,lo_num) AS VARCHAR(50)) end AS SRC_ID_NUMBER, CAST(PROD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(50)) AS PRODUCT_TYPE, CAST(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 1 THEN '1000000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 2 THEN '100000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 3 THEN '10000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD ) = 4 THEN '1000000000' || SRC_CD END AS DECIMAL(14,0)) AS CHANNEL_ID,
CAST(DCSN AS VARCHAR(50)) AS STATUS , --CAST (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY AS VARCHAR (10)) AS LOAN_SUB_TYPE_KEY, CASE WHEN UPPER(PRODUCT_TYPE) LIKE '%CREDIT CARD%' THEN CARD_TYPE ELSE CAST (PROD_SBTYPE_KEY AS VARCHAR (10)) END AS JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP ,APP_SALV_DT ,DCSN_RSN ,CASE WHEN /*PROD_SBTYPE_KEY = '900' or*/ PRODUCT_TYPE='CREDIT CARD' THEN '110' WHEN PROD_SBTYPE_KEY IN ('950', '975') THEN '135' WHEN PROD_SBTYPE_KEY IN ('022', '025', '026', '027', '030', '032') THEN '200' WHEN PROD_SBTYPE_KEY IN ('064', '065', '066') THEN '110' WHEN PROD_SBTYPE_KEY IN (801, 802, 803) THEN '110' WHEN JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP in ('Mortgage LOAN') then '110' ELSE NULL END AS COMMON_COA_ID
/*SELECT cust_key, COALESCE(card_no ,prod_key,lo_num)as prod_key ,card_no */
FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_LO lo
LEFT JOIN BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_LO_LD ld ON ld.ORG_LO_KEY=lo.LO_NUM where DCSN_DT BETWEEN TRUNC($$Date, 'MM') AND $$Date AND RCORD_FLG='D' AND $$Date BETWEEN STRT_DT AND END_DT --and cust_key='1401444067'
UNION SELECT MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY AS APPLICATION_ID, CAST(LOAN_CCY_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS ISO_CURRENCY_CD, CAST(1 AS INT) AS Volume, DISBD_AMT AS TRANS_AMOUNT, CAST('AFU' AS VARCHAR(3)) AS TRANSACTION_GROUP, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_ID, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUS_KEY, CAST(CUST_KEY AS VARCHAR(50)) AS CUSTOMER_ID, CAST($$Date AS DATE) AS AS_OF_DATE, CAST(COALESCE(PROD_KEY ,MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY) AS VARCHAR(50)) AS SRC_ID_NUMBER, CAST(PROD_TYPE AS VARCHAR(50)) AS PRODUCT_TYPE, CAST(CASE WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD) = 1 THEN '1000000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD) = 2 THEN '100000000000' || SRC_CD WHEN LENGTH(SRC_CD) = 3 THEN '10000000000' || SRC_CD END AS DECIMAL(14,0)) AS CHANNEL_ID, CAST(DCSN AS VARCHAR(50)) AS STATUS, 'Mortgage LOAN' AS JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP, RVSD_DT , DCSN_RSN, CASE WHEN JOIN_PRODUCT_MAP = 'Mortgage LOAN' THEN '110' ELSE NULL END AS COMMON_COA_ID FROM ( SELECT MG_LO_KEY, CUST_KEY, ID_NO, ED_LVL, SRC_CD, PRG_CD, SLS_AGNT_CD, DCSN, DCSN_DT, INSTL_AMT, SEGMT_CD, CUST_SEGMT, DCSN_RSN, RECVD_DT, DISBD_AMT, PROD_TYPE, PROD_KEY, LOAN_CCY_KEY, RVSD_DT FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_MG_LO WHERE $$Date BETWEEN STRT_DT AND END_DT AND DCSN_DT BETWEEN TRUNC($$Date,'MM') AND $$Date AND RCORD_FLG = 'D' ) MG_LO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MG_LO_KEY, ENGL_NM, GNDR, NTLTY_KEY, MRTL_STS, CUST_HOME_NUM, BIRTH_DT FROM BUSNSVLT_VW.BV_MG_LO_CUST WHERE $$Date BETWEEN STRT_DT AND END_DT AND RCORD_FLG = 'D' ) LO_CUST ON LO_CUST.MG_LO_KEY = MG_LO.MG_LO_KEY
